text:
maria: Main is red on CI after the merge at 1778894000. Failing job: //e2e/serving:smoke_test on linux-x64. CI link: https://ci.internal.redwood/job/4823 :exclamation:
ci-bot: build 4823 failed on linux-x64 - test //e2e/serving:smoke_test (timeout)
jon: ugh. last green for main? can someone paste the commit sha? :eyes:
maria: last green was 1778893200 (sha: a1f4c2d). The merge that went in is PR#2048 by @ash (sha: b3d9f77).
ash: (typo) i meant ash: Ash merged a small change to request scheduler timeouts in that PR.
ash: sorry ignore, re-posting
ash: ash: yep, that was mine - bumped default kv-cache timeout and tweaked scheduling backoff. didn't touch e2e directly but could affect timing.
linda: if that's the likely suspect we should bisect quickly. we don't want main sitting red for long.
jon: i'll take the bisect. plan: git bisect between a1f4c2d (good) and HEAD (bad). steps below.
jon: ```
# from a clean clone
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git reset --hard origin/main
git bisect start HEAD a1f4c2d
# mark commits as bad/good while running the e2e smoke locally or via CI job
```
maria: repro notes: locally the e2e/serving:smoke_test only fails under linux with --dockerized=true and when run in parallel with the kv-cache integration tests. single-run looks flaky but reproducible with `--repeat 5`.
sam: can we just rerun the CI job quickly to see if it's a flake?
ci-bot: rerun requested by sam - queued rebuild 4824 (same matrix).
jon: rerun is fine as a sanity check, but if it's consistent we need a bisect. i'll start a bisect job on a spare machine and post progress.
ash: ash: if jon's bisect points to my PR i can prepare a revert PR now, just tell me the culprit sha.
ash: also fyi the PR bumped grpc and a transitive dep on libuv; could be unrelated but worth checking.
maria: noting that the failure is a timeout at 120s in the test harness: `[ERROR] e2e/serving:smoke_test  Timed out after 120s`. test log snippet: ```
[2026-03-17T12:34:10Z] request stalled waiting for kv-cache response
[2026-03-17T12:36:10Z] test harness timed out
```
jon: thanks — i'll run `git bisect` with a build-and-run script that executes the same harness (dockerized). will report back within an hour.
maria: if anyone sees the bisect output drop a ping here. if it's a false negative we can close it quick.
jon: update 1778894500: bisect indicates commit b3d9f77 (PR#2048 by ash) is the first bad commit. repeating to confirm.
ash: thanks. i'm drafting a revert now and will open PR in a minute.
linda: heads up to oncall and release managers once revert is up.
sam: re-run 4824 passed on linux matrix, but bisect still points to ash's change — maybe flakey but plausible.
jon: final: confirmed via three bisect runs, root cause in scheduler timeout tweak. ash please coordinate a revert or patch.
maria: thanks team. I'll watch CI and coordinate the revert+patch rollout. :thumbsup:
